d:
Also available on popular online streaming platforms like Itunes, Spotify, Amazon and Saavn.
Check out the latest musical single from Sounds of Isha, in anticipation of the MahaShivRatri celebrations on March 4. Yogi Shiva Mahadev is a fast-paced, musical tribute to Adiyogi, and features the voices of Mohit Chauhan and Aishwarya Nigam. Enjoy!
Lyrics:
Aadi kaal se jo hai aaya
shoonya sthaan mein vo hai samayaa
anant nabh pe jo hai chhaya
anahad naad jisne sunaya
Jal vayu dharti agni
